subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Creature of habit

options.text: One who does same thing in the same way

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'One who does same thing in the same way'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"creature of habit"** means a person who follows the same routine or habits consistently; they are predictable in their actions. (आदत का गुलाम)
 
 
• **Example:** John is a creature of habit who eats the same breakfast every day and takes the same route to work.
 
 
 
• **"One who does same thing in the same way" **refers to a person who regularly follows the same routine or method without variation. (जो व्यक्ति एक ही तरह से काम करता है)
 
 
• **Example:** Sarah is one who does the same thing in the same way, ensuring her tasks are always completed with precision.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that **'creature of habit' **is synonymous with **'one who does same thing in the same way'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. 'One who does same thing in the same way'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mean person **(मतलबी व्यक्ति): Someone who is unkind or spiteful.
 
 
• **Example:** Jane is known to be a mean person who never shares her resources with anyone.
 
 
 
• **Bad habit **(बुरी आदत): A habitual action that is considered negative or harmful.
 
 
• **Example:** Smoking is a bad habit that can lead to serious health issues.
 
 
 
• **Faithful dog **(वफादार कुत्ता): A dog that shows loyalty and affection towards its owner.
 
 
• **Example:** Max is a faithful dog who always waits for his owner to return home.
